title: Tales of Pirates on Browser
author: Syndrome1337
selftext:
Back in 2005, everyone I knew was playing World of Warcraft. I couldn't afford it so my very first experience with an MMORPG was this gem of a game called 'Tales of Pirates'. This game was so impactful to me that even now, 20+ years later, I still miss it. There was just something so simple yet magical about it.

Recently, after getting ahold of the game's source code, I was able to use AI to convert all the assets so the game could run directly inside of Godot 4. Then, to take it one step further, after some pretty extreme optimizations, I was finally able to run the game directly on my browser at 60 FPS.

Granted, if a lot of players would be on the same screen, the current optimizations will likely not hold up very well but I do have some plans for that but that's a problem for future me, tonight I'm just ecstatic seeing my favorite game from my childhood running on a browser :D 

I love AI.
